definitions.explanation: unwanted intervention in someone else's affairs or an ongoing matter, often disrupting progress

examples.japanese: {横槍|よこやり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{横槍|よこやり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れないで→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいた→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{横槍|よこやり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: The plan was progressing smoothly, but the department head interfered.

examples.japanese: ⟦{外部|がいぶ}→外部：00052_gaibu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{横槍|よこやり}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{中断|ちゅうだん}→中断：05218_chuudan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The negotiations were interrupted by outside interference.

notes:
{横槍|よこやり} literally means "side spear" - the image of someone thrusting a spear in from the side during a battle.

WRITING:
- ⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧ (side, horizontal)
- {槍|やり} (spear)

ETYMOLOGY:
Originates from battlefield terminology where someone would attack from the side unexpectedly, disrupting the main engagement.

KEY EXPRESSION:
- {横槍|よこやり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (to interfere, to butt in)
- {横槍|よこやり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (interference occurs)

USAGE:
- Business: unwanted intervention from management or other departments
- Conversations: interrupting others
- Negotiations: third-party interference
- Personal matters: meddling in someone's affairs

REGISTER:
- Somewhat colloquial but widely used in both spoken and written Japanese
- Often used to express frustration with unwanted interference

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{口出|くちだ}し→口出し：21078_kuchidashi⟧ (butting in verbally)
- ⟦{干渉|かんしょう}→干渉：12445_kanshou⟧ (interference - more formal)
- ⟦{邪魔|じゃま}→邪魔：01610_jama⟧ (hindrance, obstruction)
- ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{差|さ}す→差す：17637_sasu⟧ (to throw cold water on)
